items.title: ''The Dinah Shore Chevy Show'' - 17 May 1957
items.description: An episode of Dinah Shore's popular NBC variety series. Guest stars are Art Carney, Betty Hutton, Boris Karloff. Lots of music and comedy. Before you ask for a colour version, may I remind you that no colour video-tapes survive from 1957, and colour kinescopes are exceptionally rare.

items.title: ''The Dinah Shore Chevy Show'' 11 December 1960
items.description: An episode of Dinah Shore's hour-long variety series. Guests in this episode are Ella Fitzgerald, Andy Williams, Al Hirt, and Dámaso Pérez Prado. As you might have guessed, this episode is a lot more jazzy than usual. Also contains the original commercials, all of which are for Chevrolet.
